name: Mental Monkeys
summary: dark, intricate mazes inhabited by terrifying, mutated apes. Each level presents a new labyrinth filled with unsettling twists, dead ends, and lurking dangers. Use your arms to crawl, climb, and maneuver through tight spaces as you search for an escape, all while avoiding the monstrous apes that hunt you down. Customize your character with eerie cosmetics, unlocking new looks as you progress. Join forces with friends in multiplayer mode, where communication is key to survival. Work together to solve puzzles
